policy: Assets stored locally; no runtime hotlinks. GLB models are lazy-loaded on section visibility with static fallbacks; research imagery is locally bundled and source-linked. NASA assets follow current NASA media/3D usage guidelines; no NASA endorsement of FlameLens is implied.

assets.name: International Space Station (ISS) (B)
assets.verification: glTF magic + version 2 + declared length matches file length; size matches NASA page listing (465.81 KB)
assets.licenseNote: NASA asset; follow current NASA media/3D usage guidelines.
assets.role: Hero orbital-habitat context. Compact variant chosen over the ~91 MB IGOAL model.
assets.viewerNote: Source GLB contains a detached truss cluster ~25 units above the station (authoring artifact). The viewer frames the dominant connected structure and does not render detached geometry far outside it; the file itself is unmodified.

assets.name: Apollo Lunar Module
assets.verification: glTF magic + version 2 + declared length matches file length; size matches manifest listing (700.04 KB)
assets.licenseNote: NASA asset; follow current NASA media/3D usage guidelines.
assets.role: Historical lunar-surface context only in the mission switcher. Explicitly labelled as not current lunar habitat hardware.

assets.name: Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover
assets.verification: glTF magic + version 2 + declared length matches file length; size matches NASA page listing (4.76 MB)
assets.licenseNote: NASA/JPL asset; follow current NASA media/3D usage guidelines.
assets.role: Mars tab of the mission switcher — robotic exploration context only, explicitly labelled as never a crewed pressurized rover design.

assets.name: Astronaut
assets.publisher: NASA Science 3D Resources (model by DigitalSpace Corporation)
assets.verification: glTF magic + version 2 + declared length matches file length; size matches NASA page listing (745.11 KB)
assets.licenseNote: NASA asset; follow current NASA media/3D usage guidelines.
assets.role: Static NASA astronaut; superseded by the animated scroll guide (astronaut-animated.glb). Retained in repository, not rendered.

assets.name: Animated Astronaut Character in Space Suit Loop
assets.format: GLB (glTF 2.0 binary), meshopt-compressed, skinned mesh + 91-bone armature + embedded textures
assets.verification: GLB loaded through three.js GLTFLoader with MeshoptDecoder; inspected 4 skinned mesh parts, 91 bones, bounding box ~1.011 x 1.851 x 0.824 m. Detected animation clips: wave (1.958s), idle (8.625s), floating (6.958s), moon_walk (4.625s).
assets.licenseNote: CC BY 4.0. Required credit: "Animated Astronaut Character in Space Suit Loop" by LasquetiSpice, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
assets.role: Sign-in page guide only. Loops the wave clip as a continuous greeting beside the auth panel; reduced-motion and WebGL-failure states use a static SVG fallback. Not used on the landing page.

assets.name: Tenhun Falling spaceman (FanArt)
assets.format: GLB (glTF 2.0 binary), skinned mesh + 36-bone armature + 'Idle' animation clip
assets.publisher: 3D model by wallmasterr; based on the spaceman design by Tenhun (tenhundredart.com)
assets.verification: glTF magic + version 2 + declared length matches file length; 36 bones, 10 skinned meshes, one 6.667s 'Idle' clip inspected at runtime.
assets.licenseNote: CC Attribution (CC-BY). Required credit: 'Tenhun Falling spaceman (FanArt) 3D model by wallmasterr', based on a design by Tenhun.
assets.role: Former landing-page scroll guide. Retained in repository for provenance only; not rendered after the sign-in astronaut migration.
assets.viewerNote: Source scene includes floating music-gear/debris props (keyboard, drum, microphone, wrench, headphones). The guide hides those prop meshes (Plane_0, Cube009_0, Cube011_0) so only the suited astronaut body renders; the file itself is unmodified.

assets.name: RoboCatHelper
assets.verification: GLB v2 parsed locally; 1 mesh, 1 skin, 15 nodes; embedded clips verified: Idle (2.033s), Walk (1.033s), Run (0.633s), Special (1.633s), Hit (0.533s), Attack (0.833s), Death (1.367s), 42 channels per clip.
assets.licenseNote: CC0 1.0 Universal per Gobkit free-library listing; attribution is not required. FlameLens also credits the source on the Mission Deck.
assets.role: Mica, the Mission Deck evidence-guide mascot. Uses the verified Idle loop and plays verified Special/Walk clips in response to level actions; it is not an emergency-response avatar.

decoders.origin: Bundled with three.js r170 (examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf), copied locally so Draco-compressed NASA GLBs decode without any runtime CDN dependency.
decoders.licenseNote: Draco is Apache-2.0; three.js is MIT.

notDownloaded: ISS (D) IGOAL GLB/FBX (~91 MB) — too heavy for first load; compact ISS (B) used instead
